q: In Galatians 5:22-23, love, joy, peace, patience, kindness, and self-control are the ____. (P5)
explain: The Fruit of the Spirit represents Christlike character formed by the Holy Spirit.
hint: Virtues produced by the Holy Spirit.

q: The Apostle who formerly persecuted Christians named Saul and became the great missionary to the Gentiles was ____. (P5)
explain: Paul encountered the risen Christ on the road to Damascus.

q: The first Christian martyr who was stoned to death for his faith in Christ was ____. (P5)
explain: Stephen prayed for his executioners as recorded in Acts 7.

q: The prophet swallowed by a great fish when running from God's mission to Nineveh was ____. (P5)
explain: Jonah repented inside the fish and preached repentance to Nineveh.

q: Scriptural knowledge (P5): What is Genesis?
options: the first book of the Holy Bible containing creation accounts
explain: Genesis is the first book of the Holy Bible containing creation accounts.

q: Scriptural knowledge (P5): What is Revelation?
options: the final apocalyptic book of the New Testament
explain: Revelation is the final apocalyptic book of the New Testament.

explain: Psalms is a collection of sacred songs, prayers, and hymns largely by King David.

q: Scriptural knowledge (P5): What is Matthew, Mark, Luke, and John?
options: the four canonical Gospel accounts of the life and ministry of Jesus

hint: Description of Matthew, Mark, Luke, and John.

q: Scriptural knowledge (P5): What is The Ark of the Covenant?

q: Scriptural knowledge (P5): What is Noah?

q: Scriptural knowledge (P5): What is Abraham?
options: the founding Patriarch whom God promised to make the father of many nations
explain: Abraham is the founding Patriarch whom God promised to make the father of many nations.
